notes.title: We're ending Playtest!
notes.content:
Hi Builders! 🏗️👷👷‍♀️ 

Today we are finishing playtesting! 🕹️📝

Thank you very much for participating in the tests. You helped us a lot! The main reports we received were:
- texture issues - sometimes you fell under them.
- road textures - sometimes the car would get stuck on certain roads.
- respawn issues after resetting the position.

Fortunately, most of the bugs you encountered were not critical - it was still possible to complete the levels in the playtest despite them. That doesn't change the fact that we are taking care about every report from you and fixing it! 🎮

Stay tuned for more information!

Great Day ❤️
Adam & Martin

notes.title: House Builder 2 Release Date & Closed Playtests
notes.content:
Hi Builders! 🏗️👷👷‍♀️ 

We’ve got two major announcements today – so grab your helmets and tools 🛠️
[hr][/hr]📅 Official Release Date
We’re excited to confirm that House Builder 2 will launch on October 22, 2025! 🎉
That’s when everyone will finally get the chance to dive into the next generation of building.


[previewyoutube="BvPdEpx_4Vc;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]🚨 Closed Playtests – Starting Today!
But you don’t have to wait until October to get your hands on the game…
Closed playtests start TODAY!
Selected players will get the chance to test the new mechanics early and help us polish the experience before release.

Here’s what you can expect in the playtests:

🔨 New tools & materials – more ways to design and build

🌍 Larger environments – construct homes in diverse settings

🏠 Improved building mechanics – deeper, more immersive than ever

🎨 Enhanced visuals & physics – more realistic and satisfying construction
[hr][/hr]👀 Why a Sequel?
The first House Builder showed us how much you love creating homes from the ground up. With House Builder 2, we wanted to expand every aspect – from details of construction, through bigger worlds, to a smoother and more engaging building flow.
[hr][/hr]🗓️ What’s Next
Ongoing closed playtests & feedback collection

More devlogs revealing new features and behind-the-scenes looks

Final launch on October 22, 2025 🚀
[hr][/hr]💬 Join the Community
Your feedback is invaluable – it helps us shape the best possible version of House Builder 2.
Tell us: what’s the first house you’d love to build in HB2?

Thank you for supporting us since the very beginning – let’s build something amazing together! 🏡



— The House Builder 2 Team Try out our new, premiere DLC for House Builder 1: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967780/House_Builder__Egyptian_DLC/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: FIRST DEMO UPDATE! #1👷👷‍♀️
notes.content:
Hi Builders!🏗️

Thanks to your suggestions, first HOTFIX is here! Thank you very much for your reports 💌
Here are the changes: 

🔹 player position reset button in pause menu - now when you lock yourself out, 
you can free yourself 🦋

🔹 less traffic - cars were bumping into each other or you? 😶 That's a thing of the past 😀

🔹 demolition sounds when you're working with a hammer 🔨 

🔹 Improved hammer action 🔨 - you can now smash a fence from any angle 

🔹 Improved far camera operation - arrow now always visible on the horizon ⬇️

🔹 crouching now works properly - previously you were flying into the air 🐬 

🔹 Improved loading area physics - objects will no longer fall out of the car so easily 🌐:
[previewyoutube=oEijTHMJUSs;full][/previewyoutube]
🔹 ability to rotate items you bought [R]

🔹 shortcuts 1,2,3,4,5 work now - you don't have to use the scrollbar to select items!

🔹 sleep is only until 9am - you can't sleep any longer, consequently there will be no situations where sleep could be followed by night 🌚

🔹 pop-up with thanks after opinion

🔹 and a few minor problems/improvements 🐛

We don't stop and we keep going. More updates coming soon 😀

⤵️⤵️⤵️

❗️ Remember - These are the first days of the demo. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports ❗️

notes.title: Action packed rogue-lite Sovietpunk ❌SYSTEM BREAKDOWN❌ revealed!
notes.content:

We have just announced a new game ❌System Breakdown❌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3300050/System_Breakdown/

Here you can see the announcement trailer

[previewyoutube=MreXMTWYCM4;full][/previewyoutube]


System Breakdown is a fast-paced rogue-lite shooter where you wake up in an alternate world where the Soviets won the Cold War. As the experimental new weapon of destruction, fight with Soviet War Robots to liberate a free world or anything that is left of that.
